description_en: Creates a third-party single sign-on (SSO) agent in the Cloud Customer Service System based on a user account
description_zh: 根据用户账号创建免登到客服工作台的坐席
kebab_example: aliyun scsp create-third-sso-agent --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre000 --client-id 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --account-id accountId1 --account-name accountName1 --display-name '张三' --skill-group-ids 1 --role-ids 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateThirdSsoAgent

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. Used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate this ID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain this ID from the Chinese International Chinese Smart Service console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可在悉犀客服控制台上获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The client ID issued to the tenant instance
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account to be synchronized
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the account to be synchronized
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The display name of the agent
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The list of skill group IDs
parameters.name: skill_group_ids
